description: This Python script generates a cryptographic header, computes MD5 hashes for parts of the header, writes an output file with the header, and saves the derived key in a key file. It appears to facilitate preparing encrypted firmware or data with associated cryptographic information.

methods.name: create_header(key, version, iv, random, size)
methods.description: Constructs a fixed-size header by packing key, version, iv, random, and size fields into a binary structure.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads the input file, creates a cryptographic header, writes it to the output file, computes MD5 hashes, and saves the key as a hex-encoded file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and triggers the output creation process.
